name: nextjs
description: Next.js (App Router) + React + TypeScript. The foundation rules and workflow are kept; clearly other-stack themes (Flutter, Proxmox, OPNsense, mobile release, infra-as-code, data pipeline) are simply not opted into — they live in thematic modules this preset does not request. Bundles ZERO marketplace plugins at v1 — plugin curation is added incrementally as each one is validated in real production use, not assumed. Auth, ORM, deploy and payment patterns are decisions left to the developer; see docs/recipes/saas-monetization.md if a subscription model is needed.

recommendedVendorSkills.rationale: Canonical react-best-practices and Next.js patterns from Vercel Engineering
Anthropic's official UI design plugin (avoid generic Inter+purple aesthetic)
Auth, DB, Edge Functions, Realtime, Storage patterns + Postgres best practices
Prisma ORM patterns, especially v7 (ESM-only, driver adapters)
shadcn/ui CLI v4, Radix + Base UI primitives, theming patterns

outOfScope: Payment processing — see docs/recipes/saas-monetization.md if subscription/billing is needed
Native mobile companion — use a Flutter or Swift preset (community contributions wanted)
Backend in non-Node languages — see roadmap for Django, FastAPI, Rails, Laravel, etc.

Vendor-specific React/Next.js patterns — pair this preset with the vendor skill at vercel-labs/agent-skills (react-best-practices) for canonical Vercel guidance; see specs/marketplace-audit/dev-skills-pilot-2026-05-05.md
